verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents its own API, with scoped API access tokens for building integrations. Its first-party CLI manages flags, account members, projects, environments, teams and other resources from the command line, so programmatic coverage is broad. But no evidence states that the API matches everything the UI can do, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec at the checked paths. missing for 10: an explicit statement or documented proof that every UI capability is exposed through the API, a discoverable OpenAPI/reference spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of API completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can scope your API tokens to restrict the set of operations they can perform. For example, you can build an integration that only has read access
set up and manage your feature flags, account members, projects, environments, teams, and other resources directly from the command line.
